title: 第15章 武道体系和血脉体系第16章 啊
content_zh:
驱逐了那群域外天魔之后。
剩下的问题，就是内部问题了。
归墟就那么大。
人族要繁衍。
灵兽的各自族群，也需要足够的生存土地。
一开始，各自还算克制。
慢慢摩擦也就越来越大。
总之，就是双方再次发生大战，最后灵兽一族败退，裹挟了大量人族逃到了北疆的群山之中，成了武人口中的妖魔。
而剩余的人类高层，又因为获得血脉之后，彼此之间的繁衍十分困难，分成了两个派系。
一个派系，便是血脉世家。
血脉世家，只在彼此之间通婚，攻伐苦境的收获，也全部用来献祭仙神，获得血脉上的升华。
另外一个派系，则是选择和原生人族繁衍，主动削弱血脉。
削弱血脉之后。
后辈觉醒仙骨的概率越来越低，但一旦觉醒，在武道一途，就具有碾压的天赋。
渐渐地，仙骨也就成了如今的武骨。
武道体系，靠着苦境那边的大量资源，重新成为了如今的主流体系，渐渐有了上古时期记载的几分辉煌。
长成武骨的人，因为形成战力较快，也被各大门派当做天赋种子，直接列为真传，用来作为反攻苦境的主要战力。
...
听王孝这么一说，李青山就放松了许多。
原来是自己多想了。

武骨，是仙骨。
这一血脉，经过数万年繁衍，已经给所有人族都换血了一遍。
那还怕个屁。
没了压力，李青山也就放开了许多。
他看向不知从哪掏出酒壶，细细品味的王孝：“王教习，说说鼎国和武盟的事情呗，我们成为武人了，以后岂不是还要被征兵，参与和鼎国的厮杀？”
王孝放下酒壶，点点头：
“这是自然，每一个门派，至少都有一个苦境入口。
苦境，也是我们武人赖以生存的根本。
鼎国要和我们抢夺这些入口，就是毁道之仇。
所以每年边境都会发生大规模的厮杀。
但这些和我们关系不大。
我们铁腿门，靠近西海，算是归墟最西边区域。
前线给人，我们给资源。
我们最大的压力，是武税。
不过我们铁腿门，在苦境中圈养了大量的暴食之豚，所以这方面的压力也不大。
你不用想太多。”
听王孝这么一说，李青山就更放松了。
重活一世。
他还是挺怕死的。
特别是这个世界，居然有仙神踪影。
content_en:
After expelling the group of extraterrestrial demons.
The remaining problems are internal ones.
Guixu is just that big.
The human race wants to reproduce.
The respective groups of spiritual beasts also need enough land to survive.
At first, each was relatively restrained.
Slowly the friction becomes greater and greater.
In short, there was another war between the two sides. In the end, the spirit beast clan was defeated, taking a large number of humans and fleeing to the mountains of northern Xinjiang, becoming what the warriors called a monster.
The remaining high-level human beings were divided into two factions because it was very difficult for them to reproduce with each other after acquiring the bloodline.
One faction is the Bloodline Family.
Bloodline families only intermarry with each other, and all the gains from conquering the misery are used to sacrifice to the gods and gain bloodline sublimation.
The other faction chose to breed with the native human race and actively weaken the bloodline.
After weakening the bloodline.
The probability of the younger generation awakening the Immortal Bone is getting lower and lower, but once awakened, they will have the talent to crush them in the martial arts.
Gradually, the immortal bones became today's martial bones.
The martial arts system, relying on the large amount of resources on the other side of the Dilemma, has become the mainstream system again, and gradually has some of the glory recorded in ancient times.
People who have grown into martial bones, because they develop combat power quickly, are also regarded as talent seeds by various sects, and are directly listed as true successors, and used as the main combat power to counterattack the difficult situation.
...
After hearing what Wang Xiao said, Li Qingshan relaxed a lot.
It turned out that I was overthinking it.
Martial bones are immortal bones.
This bloodline, after tens of thousands of years of reproduction, has replaced all races.
That's nothing to be afraid of.
Without the pressure, Li Qingshan relaxed a lot.
He looked at Wang Xiao who had taken out a wine bottle from somewhere and tasted it carefully: "Wang Jiaoxi, let's talk about the Ding Kingdom and the Martial Alliance. Now that we have become warriors, won't we have to be recruited into the army and participate in the fight with the Ding Kingdom?"
Wang Xiao put down the wine bottle and nodded:
"This is natural, every sect has at least one entrance to a miserable state.
Difficulty is also the basis for our warriors to survive.
The Ding Kingdom wants to snatch these entrances from us, which is the hatred of destroying the Tao.
Therefore, large-scale fighting occurs on the border every year.
But these have little to do with us.
Our Iron Leg Gate is close to the West Sea and is considered the westernmost area of Guixu.
The frontline gives people, and we give resources.
Our biggest pressure is military tax.
However, our Iron Leg Sect has kept a large number of gluttonous dolphins in captivity in a difficult situation, so the pressure in this area is not great.
You don't have to think too much. "
After hearing what Wang Xiao said, Li Qingshan became even more relaxed.
Live a new life.
He is still quite afraid of death.
Especially in this world, there are actually traces of immortals and gods.
